name: Nebula Ink Reaches
introDiscord: Clouds of violet nebula ink drift through the trench. Nebula Ink Squid have covered nearly every available surface with swirling patterns. Shizuki apparently decided this was an art gallery.
introTwitch: Clouds of violet nebula ink drift through the trench. Nebula Ink Squid have covered nearly every available surface with swirling patterns. Shizuki apparently decided this was an art gallery.

nebula-ink-reaches-approach.prompt: Three routes disappear behind curtains of violet ink.

left.message: Shizuki's tonic rests beside a squid painting labeled: "Untitled #4. Artist refused interview."
left.fullHpMessage: You leave the gallery medicine untouched.

right.message: A Nebula Ink Squid emerges and immediately adds you to the composition.

forward.message: A star-chart coffer hides beneath a violet cloud.

nebula-ink-reaches-depths.prompt: Three galleries of natural stone are covered in increasingly elaborate ink patterns.

left.message:
A Berry rests beside Shizuki's handwritten review:

"★★★★★
Excellent use of purple.
Artist threw ink at critic."

right.message: A meteor-iron reliquary has been decorated with an impressive spiral.

forward.message:
A Squid sees you examining its artwork.

The artist requests feedback violently.

nebula-ink-reaches-threshold.prompt: Violet Stormwell churns beyond three ink-filled passages.

left.message: A Squid emerges from a cloud shaped suspiciously like Shizuki.

right.message: Shizuki's tonic reads: "For art-related injuries. Surprisingly common."
right.fullHpMessage: You leave the art-related medicine untouched.

forward.message:
"Star Candies glitter beneath violet ink."

BOSS:

boss-antechamber.name: Violet Stormwell
boss-antechamber.prompt: The entire gallery darkens beneath an enormous cloud.

bossPromptDiscord:
The entire gallery darkens beneath an enormous cloud.

Something inside has produced a LOT of ink.

Use /yes to enter Violet Stormwell or /no to leave the artist to its creative process.
bossPromptTwitch:
The entire gallery darkens beneath an enormous cloud.

Something inside has produced a LOT of ink.

Use !yes to enter Violet Stormwell or !no to leave the artist to its creative process.
bossRetreatText: You retreat. A fresh ink spiral appears where you were standing.

boss.revealText:
Tentacles tear through the violet cloud.

Cloudveil Krakenet reveals itself!

completionText:
"The violet storm disperses.

One final ink blot resembles a five-pointed star.

Five stars. Excellent exhibition."
